language.howToChooseYourGradeIntro: Our curriculum Grades K to 6 corresponds with ages:
language.howToChooseYourGradeContent:
It’s very important children start at the right level, have fun in learning and work at their own pace. Please help the children selecting the level that is not too easy, but also not too difficult for them. There are two ways to do this.

  • You can either check the learning goals yourself to determine the correct level for your child(ren).
  • Or you can let the child take several lessons to determine his or her level. For example, if your child has the age of 6, please let him or her take one lesson in grade K, one lesson in grade 1, and one lesson in grade 2 to determine at which level he or she is.

dialog.text: Hi, I'm Chip.
Hi there! My name is Carlos, and this is my street band, "The Take Aways." We’re going to play you a few songs today.
We are hoping that you would help us make sure that everything goes smoothly during our performance.
We need to know how many people are in our audience, what instruments we need for each song, and a few other things throughout our evening of fun.
Can you help us? All you’ll need to know is how to subtract.
Right now it looks like there are 1, 2, 3, 4, 5…6 people in the audience ready to hear us play.
Uh oh! 2 people just left. It looks like there are only 4 people ready to hear us now.
When you subtract two numbers, you are “taking away” the amount that is being subtracted.
For example, if you have 6 people in the audience and you take away 2, you only have 4 people left.
It looks like there are four people ready to hear some music.
